The founder of CNN, **Ted Turner**, married **Jane Shirley Smith** as his second wife.  
She was a Delta Air Lines flight attendant, and they were married from 1964 (June 2) until their divorce in 1988, raising three children together. (Source: People.com article “What to Know About Ted Turner's 3 Ex‑Wives, Including Actress Jane Fonda” – see section on Jane Shirley Smith.)
